description: About 300 character classes with labeled images, widely used as a benchmark
notes: Decoded only (labeled classes). Has images: yes. Introduced at ICDAR 2019; hosting location unconfirmed.

notes: Decoded only (labeled classes). Has images: yes (small MNIST-style grayscale). Good for quick experiments.

notes: Decoded only. Has images: yes (glyph forms). Easy way to look up a decoded character.

notes: Decoded only. Has images: yes (glyph evolution). Good for learning and quick browsing.

notes: Decoded only. Has images: yes (varies by character). Coverage is uneven.

notes: Decoded + undecoded: raw excavation material. Has images: yes (rubbings). Look for the Anyang and oracle bone collections.

notes: Decoded + undecoded: discusses deciphered and disputed signs. Has images: yes (glyph tables). The standard scholarly reference for decoding notes.

notes: Decoded + undecoded: includes unidentified signs. Has images: yes (glyph tables). Useful for glyph variants.

description: Sign list of oracle bone characters
notes: Mainly decoded signs. Has images: yes (glyph tables). Updated compilation.

description: An open dataset for oracle bone character recognition and decipherment: 77,064 images / 1,588 deciphered + 62,989 images / 9,411 undeciphered signs
notes: Nature Scientific Data, 2024. Companion paper to the HUST-OBC git-repo row above. Image-only, no semantic network.

description: Deciphering Oracle Bone Language with Diffusion Models: conditional diffusion model generates candidate modern-character glyphs from an oracle glyph
notes: ACL 2024 Best Paper. Purely visual/generative; no meaning graph.

description: Deciphering Ancient Chinese Characters with Radical Reconstruction: decomposes oracle bone script into strokes/radicals, reconstructs the modern counterpart via Transformer
notes: ICDAR 2024. Introduces the ACCP dataset. Structural decomposition, not meaning.

description: Zero-shot Character Recognition via Radical-based Reasoning: radical identification plus reasoning over a Character Knowledge Graph
notes: IJCAI 2023. Introduces the OracleRC dataset. Graph of radical/structure relations, not curated meanings.

description: Towards Unified Visual-Linguistic Understanding of Oracle Bone Scripts through Cross-Modal Knowledge Fusion: LLaVA-based LVLM plus graph-based semantic reasoning, new OracleSem dataset (1,762 annotated characters)
notes: 2024. Closest prior work to this project's plan, but its graph is built from annotating the 1,762 oracle characters themselves, not a pre-existing full-lexicon network. Read closely before claiming novelty.

description: Oracle bone script decipherment via human-workflow-inspired deep learning: rubbing parsing, radical/diachronic morphological analysis, corpus-based semantic alignment, philological validation
notes: Accepted, The Innovation, 2026. "Semantic" here means corpus-usage alignment, not a decomposition-meaning graph.
